name: sleeptype-s4-mislabeled

facts.pcfgA:
The following sleep states are available on this system:
    Standby (S3)
    Hibernate

    The following sleep states are not available on this system:
    Standby (S0 Low Power Idle)

note: operator ruling: S4 may be MISLABELED as S3 on some platforms; writing hiberfil inside the window + a long gap is the hard evidence that S4 actually ran
